status: AMENDMENT 3 to the training registration. It adds no prediction and changes no criterion. It fixes the details of rung 2 of the registered ladder (design.ladderIfNothingForms), which the registration left open, so that rung 2 can start now that rung 1 has ended without a formed restart.
instruction: The ladder is registered as an instruction (the user's standing instruction: if training does not produce the pattern for the range of orders considered, extend the range and continue until it is found). This amendment only fixes what the registration left unsaid for rung 2.
condition: Rung 2 is launched only if all 80 restarts of rung 1 (4 orders x 10 restarts x 2 ceilings) have ended with no restart at overlap >= 0.9; the launcher checks this itself. If one has formed, rung 2 is not run and the ladder is not climbed.

rung2.sets: the even-only code sets {0,2,4} and {0,2,4,6}, ceiling 2.0, population 64, 100 generations, 32 restarts (0-31) each, one set after the other ({0,2,4} first, {0,2,4,6} after it, --dependency=afterany), in one shared folder data/boundaryHarmonicTraining1888Hold301DoubleStripesInteriorMinus60Minus5Ceiling2EvenOrdersPopulation64/.
rung2.restartsRule: 32 restarts is the number arm C gave its {0,2,4,6} set; the registered ladder does not give a number.
rung2.libraryRule: --libraryDirs is arm B's folder (the pilot of the same ceiling and the same target). No folder of the face, the single stripe or another ceiling is used, as in Amendment 2.
rung2.randomStarts: the random starts of {0,2,4,6} use the same generator seeds as arm C's {0,2,4,6} set (the seed depends on the order set and the restart number only); only the ceiling differs, so the two are not independent draws.
rung2.summaries: read with analyzeBoundaryHarmonicTraining11x11.py (--orders for the even-only sets) over the rung's folder and, for the sizes they contain, arm B's pilot folder, tag Ceiling2EvenOrdersCombined; the rung-1 folders are summarised as Amendment 2 says.

afterRung2: G1 and G2 are read on the finished rung before anything else is launched. If rung 2 forms, the ladder ends. If it does not, rung 3 of design.ladderIfNothingForms (contiguous orders 0-8 up to 0-20 at ceiling 2.0, population 16, then 64) follows, with its own note giving its folders, restarts and library, committed before it launches.
reportingRules: Every rung is reported with its number of codes simulated. A rung that forms is reported with the route it belongs to. Rung 1 is reported as 80 restarts that did not form.
